rationale: Cross-fitted RGB correction improves a depth base but does not surpass direct joint descriptors. Evaluate the symmetric direction and a fixed bidirectional average before attributing the effect to a particular base modality.
reverse_base: Validation-selected frozen DINOv2 RGB global SVR; train-only leave-one-animal-out residuals
correction_grid: Same bandwidth multipliers [.5,1,2], alpha [.01,.1,1,10], lambda [0,.25,.5,.75,1] as the forward experiment
bidirectional_equal: Mean of the selected forward and reverse predictions, no additional parameter
bidirectional_validation: Forward/reverse convex mixture weight chosen from [0,.25,.5,.75,1] by inner-validation MAE
missing_modality: Separate availability conditions use the already trained single-modality base when only one modality is available; these are synthetic availability tests, not estimated on-farm failure rates
scope: An exploratory application-specific architecture built on existing cross-validation stacking and kernel regression. Report all controls and any null result.
